parameters.description: An array of success and encouragement criteria items.

successCriteriaItem.description: A string representing the success criteria item.

successCriteriaItemDetermination.description: A string representing the determination for the success criteria item.

successCriteriaItemEvidence.description: An array of evidence items related to the success criteria item.

successCriteriaItemFix.description:
An array of suggested fixes related to the success criteria item. If only one suggestion is needed, wrap it in an array. For example: [
'No fix needed
'] or [
'Consider using a more formal tone.
']

encouragementCriteriaItem.description: A string providing encouragement related to the success criteria.
